title: E4 snap boundary, miss path, and nearest-node selection have no direct test
detail: The only test exercising SnapToNode drags endpoints ~2px from node centers (node center y=60, radius 36). The inclusive boundary (D2==R²), miss→MissingNode via DrawPipe, nearest-of-two, and dead-node skip are untested — a <= to < regression would pass all gates.
recommended_fix: Add an automation test calling FPPCommandBus::SnapToNode directly on the golden fixture: exact-radius inclusive snap, +1px miss, two-nodes-in-range nearest-wins, and a bus-level miss drag asserting FEditError::MissingNode.

title: Real Enhanced-Input handlers and GetViewportSize branch untested; input/view fit sizes never reconciled
detail: The snap fit is fed PC->GetViewportSize while the render fit is fed widget-local geometry (a recorded 1.48x DPI discrepancy). Tests only exercise TestScreenPos + design-ref fallback; if the two spaces diverge, clicks miss rendered nodes with no failing test.
recommended_fix: Add a test (or runtime check) asserting GetViewportSize equals the view widget's local size at draw time, or feed both fits from one source; cover OnDrawStart/OnDrawEnd via a world-based automation test.

title: UPPRunView (430 lines) has zero automation coverage despite three shipped r2 regressions
evidence:
In-code regression history, PPRunView.cpp:
168:	// r2 invisible-dot bug: the dot was created + positioned but never
200:	RefreshNodes(); // node discs cover the road ends (r2 z-order fix)
299:	// added from NativeTick never painted (r2 saga — the pool=0 bug: the
grep of Source/PacketPlumberCoreTests/ for 'PPRunView|BindRun|RebuildWorld': no matches.
detail: Three view bugs shipped in this PR cycle, each caught only by manual screenshot + vision-read. Dot-pool lifecycle, topology-gen rebuild, and ClearWorld/rebuild pairing remain regression-prone with no automated pin. Semantic (non-pixel) widget tests fit U-E5 policy.
recommended_fix: Add a headless widget automation test: construct UPPRunView, BindRun to a GM, feed synthetic snapshots (spawn/cull/topology-gen bump), assert dot visibility, pool reuse, and rebuild counts.

title: flow_summary.spawned is derived differently by the two golden writers
evidence:
PPProbeCommandlet.cpp:134-137:
				 ",\"flow_summary\":{\"spawned\":%d,\"delivered\":%d,\"live\":%d,\"score\":%d}}\n"),
			ReachablePairs, TotalHops, static_cast<int32>(State.Flow.Demand.size()), State.Score,
spine_check.cpp:641:
			static_cast<int>(State.Flow.Packets.size()) + State.Score, // spawned = delivered + live
SCHEMA.md:45: | `flow_summary.spawned` | int | demand entries fired (packets constructed) |
detail: PPProbe counts demand entries seeded; spine-check counts packets constructed (delivered+live). They coincide only when every demand entry fired by the final tick — true at ticks=100, false for e.g. -ticks=50 (Demand has 11 entries, only 5 fire per PP_Flow.h Req.Tick==Tick).
recommended_fix: Derive spawned identically in both writers (count fired entries: delivered + live), or count entries with Req.Tick <= final tick in PPProbe, matching SCHEMA.md's 'fired' wording.

title: bHasLastEditError is write-only; promised rejection feedback never surfaced or tested
evidence:
PPRunGameMode.cpp:193-194 (only occurrences — grep shows no reads):
		LastEditError = Result.Error;
		bHasLastEditError = true;
PPCommandBus.cpp:8: // a valid pair — report MissingNode so the UI can give feedback.
PPRunView.cpp:426-427 (status line shows no error):
		StatusText->SetText(
			FText::FromString(FString::Printf(TEXT("tick %llu  ·  packets %d  ·  score %d  ·  20 Hz"), CurSnapshot.Tick,
detail: bHasLastEditError is set in EndDraw but never read by view, tests, or status line; the 'UI can give feedback' promise is unimplemented. GetLastEditErrorForTest is only asserted == None (happy path), never a rejection.
recommended_fix: Either surface LastEditError in the status text (and assert a rejection sets it) or delete bHasLastEditError; add a rejection-path input test asserting a non-None LastEditError.

title: Story 1.2 'appear instantly (same frame)' is not delivered by EndDraw's immediate BuildSnapshot and has no test
detail: BuildSnapshot() keeps the same Tick, and NativeTick rebuilds the world only when Tick changes, so the pipe paints at the next 20 Hz tick (≤50 ms), not this frame — the code's own earlier comment concedes 'The view refreshes on the next step.' No test pins the criterion.
recommended_fix: Gate the view rebuild on TopologyGen change as well as Tick, or trigger RebuildWorld from EndDraw; add a test asserting the view rebuilds after a same-tick draw.
